Flow.description: When a termination is reverted, the credit (correction) order of that termination stays behind, and Subscription25 keeps Corrected_Until__c on the original order lines and Exclude_From_Corrections__c on the contract products. A new termination then only corrects the difference (e.g. +1 day) instead of the full credit. This flow reopens the contract products with the same termination date (dates cleared, Status Activated, Exclude_From_Corrections__c false; rbb_Contract does the same on the Contract itself), resets both markers and removes the credit: a Draft (not invoiced) credit order is deleted at the end of the flow, an invoiced (Activated) credit order is reversed with a Draft clone (ParentId__c = original, unit price * -1). Runs async (after commit), so Rest_UpsertContract can't overwrite the Exclude_From_Corrections__c reset in the same transaction. The prior termination date is stamped on Termination_Date_Reverted__c by rbb_Contract, because $Record__Prior isn't available in async paths. Subscription25 blocks updates on a Terminated contract product, so the flow switches the Subscription25 setting ERU_ILUVATAR on at the start and restores its original value at the end (same transaction, also on every early exit).
Flow.label: rau - Contract - Termination Reverted

recordDeletes.description: Delete the Draft (not invoiced) credit orders of the reverted termination; done last, after all markers are reset.
recordDeletes.name: ddr_14_Order
recordDeletes.label: 14. Order

recordLookups.description: Invoiced credit orders that already have a reversal clone (earlier revert) must not be reversed again.
recordLookups.name: dgr_03_ReversedOrder
recordLookups.label: 3. Reversed Order

recordLookups.description: Only the correction lines; an order without correction lines (e.g. a regular next period) is left alone.
recordLookups.name: dgr_03_CreditOrderItem
recordLookups.label: 3. Credit Order Item

recordLookups.description: Orders of this contract starting on/after the reverted termination date (credit starts on termination date + 1, or on the date itself when it equals the contract start date): Draft and not invoiced (to delete) or Activated and invoiced (to reverse). Clones/credits (ParentId__c filled) are never picked up.
recordLookups.name: dgr_01_Order
recordLookups.label: 1. Order
recordLookups.filterLogic: 1 AND 2 AND 3 AND ((4 AND 5) OR (6 AND 7))

recordUpdates.description: Original (invoiced) lines that Subscription25 marked as corrected by the credit: same recurring order product, Corrected_Until__c = start of the credit line.
recordUpdates.name: dur_07_OrderItem
recordUpdates.label: 7. Order Item
